I have been farming these 18 mu in Quzhou for 15 years now. My layout is 12 mu in wheat-maize double cropping, 3 mu in chili, and 3 mu in cotton. I am not changing anything this year because last year the yields were stable and my neighbor Lao Zhang lost money trying a new cotton variety he saw advertised.

For wheat, I plant Jimai 26, an improved variety. Last year I got about 500 kg per mu. This year I am aiming for the same. I put one 50 kg bag of compound fertilizer 15-15-15 per mu as base dressing. At green-up I spread 20 kg urea, and another 10 kg urea at heading stage. Total nitrogen is about 20 kg per mu. I know the people at the agricultural supply shop say 15 kg is enough, but three years ago I cut back to 15 kg and my wheat turned yellow and only gave 400 kg. A 50 kg bag of urea costs 130 yuan. Losing 100 kg of wheat costs me over 250 yuan. Better to put in a bit too much. I irrigate four times: wintering water, jointing, heading, and grain filling. My well pump uses electricity, about 30 yuan per mu each time. I spray pesticide twice: once for aphids in spring, once for rust at heading. Before sowing in October, I hire a rotary tiller for 40 yuan per mu.

For summer maize, I plant Zhengdan 958 hybrid seed. Right after wheat harvest in early June, I use the no-tillage seeder to plant. Saves me three days and keeps the soil moisture. I put 50 kg compound fertilizer per mu at sowing, then 20 kg urea at big trumpet stage. That is about 16 kg nitrogen, 7 kg phosphorus, 7 kg potassium. I irrigate three times if the rain does not come: seedling stage, big trumpet, and filling stage. Two pesticide sprays for corn borers and leaf blight. Last year I got 550 kg per mu, and I expect the same this year.

My 3 mu of chili uses an improved variety I buy from the seed dealer in town. I plough that plot deep in April because chili roots need loose soil. Per mu I put one 50 kg bag of compound fertilizer plus 20 kg potassium sulfate as base. Then at first flowering I top-dress with 15 kg urea. Total is about 15 kg nitrogen, 7 kg phosphorus, and 15 kg potassium. Chili needs plenty of potassium or the peppers stay small and thin. I irrigate five times from transplanting to harvest. Four pesticide sprays because chili gets spider mites and blight every year. If the weather cooperates I expect 2500 kg of fresh chili per mu.

The 3 mu of cotton is Bt hybrid. I plough in April and put one 50 kg bag of compound fertilizer per mu as base. At flowering and early boll stage I spread 20 kg urea per mu. Total about 17 kg nitrogen, 7 kg phosphorus, 7 kg potassium. Four irrigations through the season. Three pesticide sprays — even with Bt cotton I still get aphids and whitefly. Expected yield is 300 kg seed cotton per mu.

My son works in a factory in Handan and sends home 2000 yuan a month, so I have cash for inputs when I need it. But I still watch every yuan. The total fertilizer bill for all 18 mu will run about 4500 yuan this year. That is a lot of money, but a bad harvest would cost me 15,000 yuan in lost income. I would rather spend on fertilizer than risk it. For wheat harvest and peak labor I hire two workers at 100 yuan per day, but most of the work I do myself with my wife.
